These are flexible, familiar, expansive, and precise.
Mac Apps are flexible,

Mac apps are expansive.

in drill-in style navigation stacks.
Concretely, expansive means using controls like sidebars
with outline views and thumbnail previews,
popovers for transient elements,
tabs to toggle between panes of controls,
